title: El que volvió
goal: Talk to a man who went south for work and came back with nothing
culture: Half this barrio has somebody in Costa Rica or Panama. Some came back with a house and some came back with nothing, and he is neither a success story nor a warning — he made a decision, it went how it went, and he would like to tell somebody about it without being pitied for it.

beats.es: Yo estuve fuera, ¿sabe? Cinco años estuve.
beats.good: He will answer me fui a Costa Rica. Se fue from you, me fui from him — the same trip from the two ends of it, which is the pattern this whole game runs on.

beats.es: Me fui a Costa Rica. A cortar café primero, después construcción.
beats.objective: Ask what it was like there
beats.en: And what was it like over there?
beats.good: Allá is over there, wherever there is. In this barrio it means Costa Rica or Panama and nobody has to say which.

beats.es: Uy. No es como dicen, le voy a ser sincero.
beats.good: No es como dicen — it is not how they tell it. He is not warning you off; he is correcting a story the whole street believes.

beats.es: Trabajé bien duro cinco años y volví igual que me fui. Pero aquí estoy mejor.
beats.good: Agreement, not sympathy. He did not tell you this to be pitied and aquí estoy mejor is the sentence he came home with — he means it.
